title: Government Resolution On Education Policy1913
definition: A formal policy statement issued by the British Government in 1913, following the Gokhale Bill's rejection, which rejected the policy of compulsory primary education but committed to improving the quality of primary and higher education.
importanceInUpsc: It marks a critical shift in British educational policy from 'quantity' (mass expansion) to 'quality' (improvement of standards) and serves as a precursor to the Montagu-Chelmsford reforms.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Government Resolution On Education Policy1913.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
